purpose: Language-pack template (declarative-only) — not the app's shipped English
llmContext: Documentation-only language pack TEMPLATE (no test uses it as a fixture). Declares locale "en" via contributes.translations with a small illustrative subset of entries (not full ko.json coverage). There is NO runtime registration API for language packs — the manifest declaration is the entire contract, and the core (src-tauri/src/plugin_i18n.rs) scans installed manifests directly, so no plugin sandbox and no host snapshot are involved. English itself ships as a BUNDLED language pack (src/plugin/builtin/language-packs/language-pack-en, loaded by each window's bootstrap via src/i18n/packs.ts, issue #30). Use this folder as the starting point for a full-coverage pack for ANOTHER language: copy it, change `locale`/`label`, and fill `entries` from src/i18n/ko.json's full key set (the bundled English pack is a full-size worked example). main.js is intentionally whitespace-only: the host skips creating a sandbox entirely when the entry code is blank (see docs/plugin/manifest.schema.json's `contributes` description). Collection requires all four of: enabled, current OS supported, kind: "capability", and permission `i18n` — a mismatch is skipped silently, so verify with `npm run plugin -- lint <folder>`.
